note: One registry of error codes for the API and the web app. The API answers every refusal as {ok:false, code, text, field, request_id, detail}; the web app shows title, what, why and todo for the code. Owner: app/api lane. Add a code here first, then use it.

codes.title: That request was not understood
codes.what: One part of the address or its options was not in the form this page expects.
codes.why: A value was missing, too long, or not the kind of value that field takes. The reply names the field.
codes.todo: Go back and open the page from a link inside the app.

codes.title: That is not a date we can read
codes.what: The night in the address is not a calendar date.
codes.why: Dates look like 2026-11-16.
codes.todo: Pick a night from the list on the home screen.

codes.title: No games stored for that night
codes.what: There is no slate for that date in the data we hold.
codes.why: The night is outside the stored range, or no games were played.
codes.todo: Pick a night from the list on the home screen.

codes.title: We could not find that game
codes.what: No game with that id is in the data we hold.
codes.why: The link is old or mistyped, or the game is outside the stored nights.
codes.todo: Open the game from tonight's list.

codes.title: That player is not in that game
codes.what: The player id is not on either team's list for that game.
codes.why: The link is old or mistyped, or the player was not forecast for that game.
codes.todo: Open the player from the game page.

codes.title: That stat is not one we forecast
codes.what: The stat in the address is not one of the stats we store.
codes.why: We forecast points, rebounds, assists and threes; some pages add a few more.
codes.todo: Open the stat from the player's page.

codes.title: No forecast for that player and stat
codes.what: We hold no stored forecast for that combination.
codes.why: The model did not forecast that player that night (for example he was listed out), or no line was posted.
codes.todo: Choose another player or stat from the game page.

codes.title: No stored forecast for that game
codes.what: We hold no stored winner forecast for that game.
codes.why: The game is in the data, but no pre-tip winner forecast was stored for it, or none that the app shows.
codes.todo: Open the game from tonight's list, or pick another game.

codes.title: No finished prop with a posted line
codes.what: There is no settled prop with a line for that player and stat.
codes.why: The game has not finished, or no book posted a line.
codes.todo: Try another player, or come back after the game.

codes.title: That game has not been played yet
codes.what: Results exist only for finished games.
codes.why: The game is still to come or in progress.
codes.todo: Come back after the final whistle.

codes.title: History is not loaded
codes.what: The history this page needs is not part of the data being served.
codes.why: The export being served does not carry it.
codes.todo: Nothing to do; the rest of the app still works.

codes.title: No live feed for that game
codes.what: We have no live capture for that game.
codes.why: The capture did not run for it, or the game is not on tonight's feed.
codes.todo: Go back to the Live list.

codes.title: No desk file yet
codes.what: The desk export has not been written.
codes.why: The desk is written by a separate job and only on the owner's machine.
codes.todo: Nothing to do.

codes.title: The desk file failed its checks
codes.what: The desk file exists but was not served.
codes.why: It did not match the allowed shape, so it was refused rather than shown.
codes.todo: Rebuild the desk export.

codes.title: No ticket list for that night
codes.what: There is no top-parlays file for that date.
codes.why: The ticket job did not run for that night.
codes.todo: Pick another night.

codes.title: The ticket list failed its checks
codes.what: The file exists but was not served.
codes.why: It did not match the contract, so it was refused rather than shown.
codes.todo: Rebuild the ticket file.

codes.title: The ticket list cannot be read right now
codes.what: The file could not be opened.
codes.why: It may be mid-write.
codes.todo: Try again in a minute.

codes.title: No combo file for that night
codes.what: There is no combo-mode file for that date.
codes.why: The combo job did not run for that night, or it has not been written yet.
codes.todo: Pick another night.

codes.title: The combo file failed its checks
codes.what: The file exists but was not served.
codes.why: It did not match the combo contract, so it was refused rather than shown.
codes.todo: Rebuild the combo file.

codes.title: The combo file cannot be read right now
codes.what: The folder holding the combo files could not be read.
codes.why: It may be mid-write.
codes.todo: Try again in a minute.

codes.title: No parlay check stored for that night
codes.what: The parlay engine's records for that date are not in the data we hold.
codes.why: The data holds the engine's records for one night only, the night of the latest export.
codes.todo: Open the parlay page from the home screen.

codes.title: Today's data failed its checks
codes.what: We are not showing the nightly data until it passes its checks.
codes.why: The manifest or a file's checksum did not match, or the file is incomplete. Nothing shown elsewhere is stale or made up.
codes.todo: Try again in a few minutes; the next export replaces it.

codes.title: Too many live viewers right now
codes.what: The live feed has reached its limit of open streams.
codes.why: Each open Live page holds one stream.
codes.todo: Close other Live tabs and try again shortly.

codes.title: There is nothing at that address
codes.what: The API has no route at that path.
codes.why: The link is old or mistyped.
codes.todo: Go back to the home screen.

codes.title: This service is read-only
codes.what: Only GET requests are answered.
codes.why: The app never writes anything.
codes.todo: Nothing to do.

codes.title: Something went wrong on our side
codes.what: The server hit an error it did not expect.
codes.why: This is a bug. The reference id identifies it in the log.
codes.todo: Try again; if it repeats, note the reference id.

codes.title: We can't reach our data right now
codes.what: The app could not reach its data service.
codes.why: The service is not running, or the connection dropped.
codes.todo: Try again in a minute. A saved copy may still open.

codes.title: You are offline
codes.what: Showing the last copy saved on this device.
codes.why: No connection.
codes.todo: Reconnect to see newer data.

codes.title: This data is old
codes.what: The data being shown was made a while ago; its age is shown.
codes.why: No newer export has arrived.
codes.todo: Check back after the next daily run.

codes.title: The live feed stopped
codes.what: No new update has arrived for a while.
codes.why: The capture stopped growing, the game ended, or the connection dropped.
codes.todo: The page retries by itself; you can also press Retry.

codes.title: We could not find that page
codes.what: The address does not match any page in the app.
codes.why: The link is old or mistyped.
codes.todo: Use the menu to go to a page.

codes.title: This page hit a problem
codes.what: Something broke while drawing this page.
codes.why: This is a bug. The reference id identifies it.
codes.todo: Go back to the home screen, or reload.
